fields.label: Security
fields.description: The instrument being purchased. Holdings are minted against this Security directly — no Item involved.

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Who is Polemarch buying from? Supplier = off-market acquisition. Customer = a Polemarch customer is selling shares back to us (proprietary Stock-in-Trade inventory gets minted; their Customer Holding snapshot is decremented as a CRM side-effect).

fields.label: Party
fields.description: Counterparty selling the shares to Polemarch.

fields.label: Supplier (legacy)
fields.description: Back-compat field. Auto-synced from `party` when party_type=Supplier so legacy reports and patches keep working.

fields.label: Initial Classification
fields.description: Where the new Investment Holding lands at create time — a one-shot hint, not a live mirror. Leave on Unallocated to keep the 2-working-day classification window. Pick Stock in Trade or Investment to skip the window and lock the classification at submit. After submit, the actual classification lives on the linked Investment Holding (which can be reclassified independently); this field hides so it doesn't drift.

fields.label: Cost To Account (DR)
fields.description: Inventory account that takes the debit. Auto-fills on save to `Securities Inventory - Trading - <abbr>` for the chosen Company. Portfolio Transfer can later move to Long-Term Investments if classified as Investment.

fields.label: Payment Method
fields.options:
Default Payable
Bank
Customer Wallet
Cash
fields.description:
How is Polemarch paying for these shares?
  - Default Payable: defer cash settlement (CR Creditors; settle later via Payment Entry)
  - Bank: pay directly from a bank account
  - Customer Wallet: credit the customer's Polemarch wallet (only valid when party_type=Customer)
  - Cash: cash on hand

fields.label: Payment Account (CR)
fields.description:
Account that takes the credit leg of the JE. Auto-fills on save based on `Payment Method` + Company defaults:
  - Default Payable → Company's default payable account (e.g. Creditors - <abbr>)
  - Bank → Company's default bank account
  - Cash → Company's default cash account
  - Customer Wallet → the customer's Wallet Liability GL

fields.label: Cost Center
fields.description: Optional. Falls back to the company's default cost center on the Journal Entry if blank.

fields.label: Journal Entry
fields.description: Auto-posted on submit: DR cost_to_account, CR paid_from_account.

fields.label: Investment Holding
fields.description: Holding minted on submit. Created in classification = Unallocated; a Polemarch officer must classify within 2 working days or it auto-rolls to Stock in Trade.
